problem: Can positivity alone type observer transformations compositionally when an observed carrier may be extended by an independently retained ancillary carrier?
bold_conjecture: Positive trace-preserving maps suffice for observer transformations; complete positivity is optional external structure.
named_rivals: complete positivity forced by arbitrary ancillary extension
restriction to classical commutative record systems
restriction to a fixed carrier with no ancillary composition

test_case.ancilla: identity on a second two-dimensional carrier

acceptance_rule: An admissible observer transformation remains positive after tensoring with the identity transformation of every independently retained ancillary carrier.
claim_boundary: The Bell witness rejects mere positivity and forces complete positivity from ancillary compositional stability in finite-dimensional matrix carriers. It does not prove that every metaphysical sector admits arbitrary ancillary composition or that Hilbert-space quantum theory is uniquely selected.
